final: WITH trans_avgs AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) as avg_anlycount FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE anlycount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY transref), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) as overall_average FROM trans_avgs), kept_trans AS (SELECT ta.transref, ta.avg_anlycount FROM trans_avgs ta, overall_avg oa WHERE ta.avg_anlycount > oa.overall_average), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) as kept_average FROM kept_trans) SELECT kt.transref, kt.avg_anlycount, kt.avg_anlycount - oa.overall_average as above_overall, kt.avg_anlycount - ka.kept_average as above_kept FROM kept_trans kt, overall_avg oa, kept_avg ka ORDER BY above_kept DESC LIMIT 10
